title: Deep learning for analyzing chaotic dynamics in biological time series: insights from frog heart signals
core_idea: Introduce an automatic algorithm that integrates deep learning with selection strategies guided by a mathematical model of the same nature as the experimental data to enable analysis of chaotic dynamics in short, noisy biological time series where standard chaos detection and conventional deep learning approaches struggle.
tldr: Proposes combining deep learning and model-based selection strategies to analyze chaotic cardiac dynamics in short, noisy biological time series (demonstrated using ex-vivo frog heart signals).
